t: This sculpture is Europe, by Patrick MacDowell. MacDowell was an Irish-born British sculptor who worked through the nineteenth century, living from 1799 to 1870. He made this piece, and it belongs to a long tradition of figures carved to stand for large ideas, here a whole continent. Take a look at how the figure is posed and what details it carries. Those will tell you more about how the sculptor pictured Europe than I can from the information I have in front of me.
